arcs.title: Operation Signal Zero
arcs.briefing: Free the rover, recover a school showcase’s missing broadcast, and leave a message for the next crew.

missions.title: The Equation Vault
missions.summary: Explore variables on both sides, solution types, equation models, and error analysis.

missions.title: Signal Checkpoint
missions.summary: Practice solving linear equations to restore a station signal.

missions.title: The Blackout Ledger
missions.summary: Fund a receiver for a missing student broadcast: compare plans, model profit, and make whole-number decisions.

missions.title: The Signal Window
missions.summary: Recover the rest of the archive: solve and graph inequalities, reverse negative division, and combine real-world limits.

assignments.title: Unit 4 · Start here
assignments.instructions: Open the Equation Vault. Follow the guided examples, complete the mastery check, then submit your downloaded mission report in your class assignment.
assignments.nextStep: After submitting your Vault report, begin Mission 2: The Blackout Ledger when your teacher directs you.

assignments.title: Mission 2 · The Blackout Ledger
assignments.instructions: After completing Equation Vault, recover the missing broadcast. Work through all four chapters, record your reasoning, complete the mastery check, and download your mission report. Submit the report through your teacher’s class assignment.
assignments.nextStep: Submit your report, then wait for your teacher to release the next mission.
